title: Hynek 1966 article on UFOs over Minot missiles
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: UFOs he stumbled upon an article that famed astronomer Jay Allen HCK had written in 1966 while running Project Blue Book the official government UFO investigations program out of the Air Force the article said that UFOs had float around nuclear missiles at Min not Air Force Base in North Dakota

plain: According to Michels, a 1966 article by the astronomer J. Allen Hynek said that UFOs had floated around the nuclear missiles at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota. Hynek, Michels notes, was then running Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's official UFO investigation. Michels tells this himself while introducing an episode with Robert Hastings, a researcher of UFOs at nuclear bases, as the article that was found early on, and if it holds, it means the government's own UFO investigator put on record that UFOs had shown up at nuclear weapons.
